title: Approximate Unlearning in Prototype-based-classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.34495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The recent data and AI regulations and governance needs have highlighted the need for removing specific data even from models trained on or with them. While retraining the entire model is a theoretically trivial solution, it is computationally expensive, thereby motivating research in Machine Unlearning. This paper introduces a robust approximate unlearning technique for the family of prototype-based classifiers called Generalized Learning Vector Quantization, aimed at removal of effects of specified samples, either due to deletion request or due to them being identified as noisy or corrupt. We first show the impact of the different sizes of the forget set, as well as the characteristics of the data in this set, on the unlearned model. To address the sources of instabilities detected in this unlearning method we propose an adapted version of this technique, such that the unlearning is robust to the characteristics of the forget set. translated_title: 基于原型的分类器中的近似遗忘
translated_abstract: 近期的数据与人工智能法规及治理需求凸显了这样一个必要性：即使模型已经在某些数据上或使用这些数据进行了训练，也需要能够从中移除这些特定数据。虽然重新训练整个模型在理论上是简单的解决方案，但其计算成本高昂，因此推动了机器遗忘领域的研究。本文针对一类称为广义学习向量量化（Generalized Learning Vector Quantization）的基于原型的分类器，提出了一种鲁棒的近似遗忘技术，旨在移除特定样本的影响，无论是由于删除请求，还是由于这些样本被识别为噪声或损坏数据。我们首先展示了遗忘集的不同规模以及该集合中数据特征对遗忘后模型的影响。为了解决在这种遗忘方法中检测到的不稳定性来源，我们提出了该技术的一个改进版本，使得遗忘过程对遗忘集的特征具有鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文针对广义学习向量量化（GLVQ）原型分类器提出了一种鲁棒的近似机器遗忘技术，通过分析遗忘集规模与数据特征对遗忘效果的影响并改进方法以消除不稳定性，实现对特定样本影响的有效移除。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a robust approximate unlearning technique for prototype-based Generalized Learning Vector Quantization classifiers, analyzing the impact of forget set size and data characteristics on the unlearned model and proposing an adapted method that ensures robust unlearning regardless of the forget set's properties.
